item.title: Nick 4.0
item.description:
Nick 4.0 — Network Protection

  • Endpoint Security and Network Filter onboarding with verified status checks
  • Scam Guardian protection for phishing and lookalike domains
  • Improved Email Guard attachment scanning and YARA detection
  • Clearer alerts, trusted-behavior controls, and threat timeline
  • Redesigned performance cleanup and security recommendations
  • Native Nick Uninstaller for complete removal and clean reinstalls
  • Performance and background-monitoring improvements

item.title: Nick 3.0.0
item.description:
Nick 3.0 — Endpoint Security Edition

  • Real-time threat detection via Apple Endpoint Security framework
  • Ransomware protection with canary files
  • ML-based behavioral analysis
  • File integrity monitoring
  • Quarantine and automated remediation
  • Privacy Guard (TCC monitoring)
  • USB auto-scan
  • Performance cleanup engine
  • Smart Scan with one-tap fix
  • User-friendly alerts
